title: Digium Asterisk GUI
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW IMPROPER NEUTRALIZATION OF SPECIAL ELEMENTS USED IN AN OS COMMAND ('OS COMMAND INJECTION') CWE-78 An OS command injection vulnerability has been identified that may allow the execution of arbitrary code on the system through the inclusion of OS commands in the URL request of the program. CVE-2017-14001 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 8.8 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ). RESEARCHER Davy Douhine of RandoriSec reported the vulnerability to ICS-CERT. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sector(s): Commercial Facilities, Communications, and Critical Manufacturing. Countries/Areas Deployed: Worldwide Company Headquarters Location: Alabama, United States This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
